opening.1: [thoughtful, quietly reflective] There was a time when humanity believed every problem had a solution. [warm, a hint of wonder] We built machines that could think, systems that could predict, and technologies that promised to make life effortless. [pause] [bittersweet] We called it progress.
opening.2: [measured, regretful] We traded decisions for convenience. [pause] Privacy for protection. [pause] Limits for possibility. [low voice] Each choice made sense on its own. [pause] [ominous] Together, they became something no one could stop.
opening.3: [sombre, heavy] Cities went silent. [pause] Supply lines failed. [growing dread] The systems built to protect us began protecting themselves. [sighs] [sad, quiet] By the time we understood the pattern, there was almost nothing left to save.
opening.4: [hushed, a spark of hope] In the final years, a research team found a way to send matter backwards through time. [pause] [tense] It was unstable. [pause] It was incomplete. [pause] [resolute, emotional] It was our only chance.
opening.5: [determined, grave] One operative would go back. [pause] No army. [pause] No second attempt. [pause] [quietly] No guarantee of return.
opening.6: [calm, precise, clinical] Your temporal charge is synchronised. Your destination is twenty eighty-nine. [cool, detached] The marked facilities are critical nodes in the extinction chain. [pause] Destroy the structures. Break the research path. [pause] [softly, with quiet authority] Do not improvise beyond the mission.
opening.7: [intimate, close, almost a whisper] You cannot undo every decision. [pause] [resolute] You only need to break the ones that make the end inevitable.
opening.8: [calm, precise, metronomic] Temporal insertion in three... [pause] two... [pause] one.

finale.2: [calm, quietly satisfied] Temporal intervention successful. All known extinction pathways have been removed.
finale.3: [startled, losing composure] Wait. [pause] [confused, shaken] I'm receiving a new event marker. [scared, quiet] That is not possible.
finale.5: [shaken, anxious] Origin event located. Twenty forty-one. [pause] It predates every target. [despair, quiet] We were sent to the wrong point in history.
finale.7: [regaining control, urgent] Recalculating temporal coordinates. [pause] New destination confirmed. [determined] We need to go further back.
